Bash(git commit -m "fix(db): prevent TOAST corruption from React Strict Mode double-mounting

**Root Cause:**
PGlite TOAST corruption errors on fresh database caused by:
1. React Strict Mode enabled (double-mounts components in dev)
2. DbProvider doesn''t close database on unmount in dev mode (for HMR)
3. First mount: Opens idb://web
4. Strict Mode unmount: Does nothing (dev mode skip)
5. Second mount: Opens idb://web AGAIN
6. Two PGlite instances accessing same IndexedDB → TOAST corruption

**Solution:**
Implemented singleton pattern in WasmLoader:
- Cache PGlite instances by dataDir path
- Reuse existing instance when same path requested
- Only create new instance if not already cached
- Prevents concurrent IndexedDB access

**Changes:**
1. Added dbCache: Map<string, PGlite> to WasmLoader class
2. Modified createPGlite() to check cache before creating instance
3. Added closeCached() method for proper cleanup
4. Caching only applies to persisted databases (idb://)
5. Memory databases (memory://) always create new instances

**Impact:**
- ✅ No more TOAST corruption in web app dev mode
- ✅ Safe with React Strict Mode double-mounting
- ✅ No interference between desktop (Electron IPC) and web (IndexedDB)
- ✅ All tests pass (278/278)

**Testing:**
- Factory reset now works correctly
- Multiple remounts reuse same instance
- Desktop and web use separate code paths
